Postman's chai assertions do not come with it — checks stay expect(value).toBe(…). You can change the name back any time in How scripts work.
api_studio.postman_dialect_note: Postman's names are bound: pm.environment, pm.response.code, pm.response.text(), pm.test. Its chai assertions are not — use expect(value).toBe(…). lz always works too.
api_studio.javascript_on_hand_desc: Scripts run as ordinary JavaScript, so the standard library is here: these globals, and the methods any value carries such as toString, trim, map and filter. There is no await, no timers, and no network of a script's own.
